type: sudo mkdir -p /tmp/cores; sudo sysctl -w kernel.core_pattern=/tmp/cores/core.%e.%p >/dev/null; ulimit -c unlimited; echo CORES_READY

rm -f /tmp/probe3.log; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do sudo -b /usr/bin/hscl-calamares; sleep 40; if pgrep -f 'calamares -D8' >/dev/null; then echo "A$i=UP" >>/tmp/probe3.log; else echo "A$i=DEAD" >>/tmp/probe3.log; fi; sudo pkill -f hscl-calamares; sudo pkill -f 'calamares -D8'; sleep 4; if [ -n "$(ls -A /tmp/cores 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo CORE_SEEN >>/tmp/probe3.log; break; fi; done; echo DONE >>/tmp/probe3.log

clear; cat /tmp/probe3.log; echo '--- cores ---'; ls -la /tmp/cores 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo '--- wrapper ---'; cat /tmp/hscl-calamares.log 2>/dev/null | tail -8; echo '--- corefile ---'; file /tmp/cores/core.* 2>/dev/null
